def _make_divisible(v, divisor, min_value=None):
    if min_value is None:
        min_value = divisor
    new_v = max(min_value, int(v + divisor / 2) // divisor * divisor)
    if new_v < 0.9 * v:
        new_v += divisor
    return new_v

class NextTransformerBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, drop_path, stride=1, sr_ratio=1, mlp_ratio=2, head_dim=32, mix_block_ratio=0.75, attn_drop=0.0, drop=0.0, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d, act_layer=nn.ReLU, device=None, dtype=None):

        super().__init__()
        self.in_chs = in_chs
        self.out_chs = out_chs
        self.mix_block_ratio = mix_block_ratio
        self.mhsa_out_chs = _make_divisible(int(out_chs * mix_block_ratio), 32)
        self.mhca_out_chs = out_chs - self.mhsa_out_chs
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbed(in_chs, self.mhsa_out_chs, stride, **dd)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(self.mhsa_out_chs, **dd)
        self.e_mhsa = EfficientAttention(self.mhsa_out_chs, head_dim=head_dim, sr_ratio=sr_ratio, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop, **dd)
        self.mhsa_drop_path = DropPath(drop_path * mix_block_ratio)
        self.projection = PatchEmbed(self.mhsa_out_chs, self.mhca_out_chs, stride=1, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd)
        self.mhca = ConvAttention(self.mhca_out_chs, head_dim=head_dim, norm_layer=norm_layer, act_layer=act_layer, **dd)

def _make_divisible(v, divisor, min_value=None):
    if min_value is None:
        min_value = divisor
    new_v = max(min_value, int(v + divisor / 2) // divisor * divisor)
    if new_v < 0.9 * v:
        new_v += divisor
    return new_v

        self.mhca_out_chs = out_chs - self.mhsa_out_chs
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbed(in_chs, self.mhsa_out_chs, stride, **dd)

def _make_divisible(v, divisor, min_value=None):
    if min_value is None:
        min_value = divisor
    new_v = max(min_value, int(v + divisor / 2) // divisor * divisor)
    if new_v < 0.9 * v:
        new_v += divisor
    return new_v

class NextTransformerBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, drop_path, stride=1, sr_ratio=1, mlp_ratio=2, head_dim=32, mix_block_ratio=0.75, attn_drop=0.0, drop=0.0, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d, act_layer=nn.ReLU, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.in_chs = in_chs
        self.out_chs = out_chs
        self.mix_block_ratio = mix_block_ratio
        self.mhsa_out_chs = _make_divisible(int(out_chs * mix_block_ratio), 32)
        self.mhca_out_chs = out_chs - self.mhsa_out_chs
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbed(in_chs, self.mhsa_out_chs, stride, **dd)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(self.mhsa_out_chs, **dd)
        self.e_mhsa = EfficientAttention(self.mhsa_out_chs, head_dim=head_dim, sr_ratio=sr_ratio, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop, **dd)
        self.mhsa_drop_path = DropPath(drop_path * mix_block_ratio)
        self.projection = PatchEmbed(self.mhsa_out_chs, self.mhca_out_chs, stride=1, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd)
        self.mhca = ConvAttention(self.mhca_out_chs, head_dim=head_dim, norm_layer=norm_layer, act_layer=act_layer, **dd)
        self.mhca_drop_path = DropPath(drop_path * (1 - mix_block_ratio))
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(out_chs, **dd)
        self.mlp = ConvMlp(out_chs, hidden_features=int(out_chs * mlp_ratio), act_layer=act_layer, drop=drop, **dd)
        self.mlp_drop_path = DropPath(drop_path)
        self.is_fused = False

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        out = self.norm1(x)
        out = out.reshape(B, C, -1).transpose(-1, -2)
        out = self.mhsa_drop_path(self.e_mhsa(out))
        x = x + out.transpose(-1, -2).reshape(B, C, H, W)

        out = out + self.mhca_drop_path(self.mhca(out))
        x = torch.cat([x, out], dim=1)
        out = self.norm2(x)
        x = x + self.mlp_drop_path(self.mlp(out))
        return x

class EfficientAttention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, out_dim=None, head_dim=32, qkv_bias=True, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0, sr_ratio=1, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm1d, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.dim = dim
        self.out_dim = out_dim if out_dim is not None else dim
        self.num_heads = self.dim // head_dim
        self.head_dim = head_dim
        self.scale = head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.fused_attn = use_fused_attn()
        self.q = nn.Linear(dim, self.dim, bias=qkv_bias, **dd)
        self.k = nn.Linear(dim, self.dim, bias=qkv_bias, **dd)
        self.v = nn.Linear(dim, self.dim, bias=qkv_bias, **dd)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(self.dim, self.out_dim, **dd)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)
        self.sr_ratio = sr_ratio
        self.N_ratio = sr_ratio ** 2
        if sr_ratio > 1:
            self.sr = nn.AvgPool1d(kernel_size=self.N_ratio, stride=self.N_ratio)
            self.norm = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        else:
            self.sr = None
            self.norm = None

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        q = self.q(x).reshape(B, N, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        if self.sr is not None:
            x = self.sr(x.transpose(1, 2))
            x = self.norm(x).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.k(x).reshape(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.v(x).reshape(B, -1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        if self.fused_attn:
            x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, dropout_p=self.attn_drop.p if self.training else 0.0)
        else:
            q = q * self.scale
            attn = q @ k.transpose(-1, -2)
            attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
            attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
            x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class _DenseLayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(_DenseLayer, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, z):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu1(self.norm1(z)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu2(self.norm2(out)))
        return out

class DenseStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(DenseStage, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([_DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)])

    def forward(self, z):
        features = [z]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)

class TransitionLayer(nn.Sequential):

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, num_output_features):
        super(TransitionLayer, self).__init__()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, num_output_features, kernel_size=1, stride=1, bias=False)
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d):
        super(Stem, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        return x

        z = self.stages(z)

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d):
        super(Stem, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        return x

from timm.layers import ConvNormAct, SelectAdaptivePool2d, SqueezeExcite, create_act_layer, create_conv2d, make_divisible, get_device_dtype
from ._builder import build_model_with_cfg
from ._features import feature_take_indices
from ._manipulate import checkpoint_seq
from ._registry import generate_default_cfgs, register_model

class RepDepthwiseSeparable(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, stride=1, dw_kernel_size=3, split_pw=False, use_rep=False, use_se=False, use_shortcut=False, pw_ratio=0.5, se_ratio=0.25, act_layer=nn.ReLU, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d, inference_mode=False, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.in_chs = in_chs
        self.out_chs = out_chs
        self.stride = stride
        self.dw_kernel_size = dw_kernel_size
        self.use_shortcut = use_shortcut and stride == 1 and (in_chs == out_chs)
        if use_rep:
            self.dw_conv_list = None
            if inference_mode:
                self.dw_conv = create_conv2d(in_chs, in_chs, kernel_size=dw_kernel_size, stride=stride, groups=in_chs, bias=True, **dd)
            else:
                self.dw_conv = None
                self.dw_conv_list = nn.ModuleList([ConvNormAct(in_chs, in_chs, kernel_size=k, stride=stride, groups=in_chs, apply_act=False, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd) for k in range(dw_kernel_size, 0, -2) if not (k == 1 and stride != 1)])
            self.dw_act = create_act_layer(act_layer, inplace=True)
        else:
            self.dw_conv_list = None
            self.dw_conv = ConvNormAct(in_chs, in_chs, kernel_size=dw_kernel_size, stride=stride, groups=in_chs, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd)
            self.dw_act = nn.Identity()
        if use_se:
            self.se = SqueezeExcite(in_chs, rd_channels=int(in_chs * se_ratio), act_layer=act_layer, gate_layer='sigmoid', **dd)
        else:
            self.se = nn.Identity()
        if split_pw:
            mid_chs = int(out_chs * pw_ratio)
            self.pw_conv = nn.Sequential(ConvNormAct(in_chs, mid_chs, kernel_size=1, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd), ConvNormAct(mid_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=1, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd))
        else:
            self.pw_conv = ConvNormAct(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=1, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd)

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x
        if self.dw_conv is not None:
            x = self.dw_act(self.dw_conv(x))
        else:
            out = self.dw_conv_list[0](x)
            for i, dw_conv in enumerate(self.dw_conv_list):
                if i > 0:
                    out = out + dw_conv(x)
            x = self.dw_act(out)
        x = self.se(x)
        x = self.pw_conv(x)
        if self.use_shortcut:
            x = x + shortcut
        return x

class LCNetV2(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, scale=1.0, depths=(2, 2, 6, 2), in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, global_pool='avg', head_hidden_size=1280, act_layer=nn.ReLU, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d, drop_rate=0.0, inference_mode=False, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.in_chans = in_chans
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.drop_rate = drop_rate
        self.grad_checkpointing = False
        block_kwargs = dict(act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, inference_mode=inference_mode, **dd)
        stem_chs = make_divisible(32 * scale)
        prev_chs = make_divisible(64 * scale)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(ConvNormAct(in_chans, stem_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd), RepDepthwiseSeparable(stem_chs, prev_chs, stride=1, dw_kernel_size=3, **block_kwargs))
        stages = []
        self.feature_info = []
        reduction = 2
        for stage_idx, (chs, dw_kernel_size, split_pw, use_rep, use_se, use_shortcut) in enumerate(_STAGE_CFG):
            out_chs = make_divisible(chs * 2 * scale)
            blocks = []
            for block_idx in range(depths[stage_idx]):
                blocks += [RepDepthwiseSeparable(in_chs=prev_chs, out_chs=out_chs, stride=2 if block_idx == 0 else 1, dw_kernel_size=dw_kernel_size, split_pw=split_pw, use_rep=use_rep, use_se=use_se, use_shortcut=use_shortcut, **block_kwargs)]
                prev_chs = out_chs
            stages += [nn.Sequential(*blocks)]
            reduction *= 2
            self.feature_info += [dict(num_chs=out_chs, reduction=reduction, module=f'stages.{stage_idx}')]
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = prev_chs
        self.head_hidden_size = head_hidden_size or self.num_features
        self.global_pool = SelectAdaptivePool2d(pool_type=global_pool)
        assert self.global_pool.feat_mult() == 1, 'Pooling that changes the pooled width is not supported.'
        if head_hidden_size:
            self.conv_head = create_conv2d(self.num_features, self.head_hidden_size, 1, bias=False, **dd)
            self.act2 = create_act_layer(act_layer, inplace=True)
        else:
            self.conv_head = nn.Identity()
            self.act2 = nn.Identity()
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1) if global_pool else nn.Identity()
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(self.head_hidden_size, num_classes, **dd) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        if self.grad_checkpointing and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
            x = checkpoint_seq(self.stages, x, flatten=True)
        else:
            x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.conv_head(x)
        x = self.act2(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        if pre_logits:
            return x
        if self.drop_rate > 0.0:
            x = F.dropout(x, p=self.drop_rate, training=self.training)
        return self.classifier(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def _create_lcnetv2(variant, pretrained=False, **kwargs):
    out_indices = kwargs.pop('out_indices', (0, 1, 2, 3))
    return build_model_with_cfg(LCNetV2, variant, pretrained, feature_cfg=dict(flatten_sequential=True, out_indices=out_indices), **kwargs)

class SqueezeExpand(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.squeeze = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand1x1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand3x3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)

        return torch.cat([F.hardswish(self.expand1x1(x), inplace=True), F.hardswish(self.expand3x3(x), inplace=True)], 1)

class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return F.hardswish(x, inplace=True)

class ConvNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = BasicConv2d(in_chans, 8, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        in_ch = 8
        self.stage1, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[0], in_ch, pool=False)
        self.stage2, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[1], in_ch, pool=True)
        self.stage3, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[2], in_ch, pool=True)
        self.stage4, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[3], in_ch, pool=True)
        self.stage5, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[4], in_ch, pool=True)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(1), nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate), nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes))

    def forward(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {x.dim()}D')
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stage1(x)
        x = self.stage2(x)
        x = self.stage3(x)
        x = self.stage4(x)
        x = self.stage5(x)
        x = x.mean((2, 3))
        return self.classifier(x)

    @staticmethod
    def _make_layer(sq, e, n, in_ch, pool=False):
        blocks = []
        if pool:
            blocks.append(nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True))
        for _ in range(n):
            blocks.append(SqueezeExpand(in_ch, sq, e, e))
            in_ch = 2 * e
        return (nn.Sequential(*blocks), in_ch)

        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup
        layers = []

            layers.append(ConvBNReLU(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvBNReLU(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=5, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

        out = self.conv(tensor)
        if self.residual:

import torch.nn as nn

from torchvision.ops import StochasticDepth
from torchvision.ops import MLP

class Attention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super(Attention, self).__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class Block(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0):
        super(Block, self).__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = Attention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, [hidden, dim], activation_layer=nn.GELU, dropout=drop)
        self.drop_path1 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class Stem(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super(Stem, self).__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer is not None else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, global_pool='token', **kwargs):
        super(ViT, self).__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.patch_embed = Stem(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        dpr = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, depth)]
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[Block(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, drop_path=dpr[i]) for i in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        x = torch.cat((self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1), x), dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

class LayerNormChannels(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

class DepthwiseMLPBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0, layer_scale_init_value=1e-06):
        super().__init__()

        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Linear(dim, 4 * dim)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Linear(self.pwconv1.out_features, dim)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(layer_scale_init_value * torch.ones(dim)) if layer_scale_init_value > 0 else None
        self.drop_path = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x
        x = self.dwconv(x)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.pwconv1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pwconv2(x)

            x = self.gamma * x
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)

        return x

        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4), LayerNormChannels(16, eps=1e-06))
        in_ch = 16
        total = sum((r[1] for r in cfg))
        dp_rates = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, total)]
        cur = 0
        for idx, (dim, n) in enumerate(cfg):

            if in_ch != dim:
                blocks.append(nn.Sequential(LayerNormChannels(in_ch, eps=1e-06), nn.Conv2d(in_ch, dim, kernel_size=2, stride=2)))
            for j in range(n):
                blocks.append(DepthwiseMLPBlock(dim, drop_path=dp_rates[cur + j]))
            cur += n
            in_ch = dim
            self.add_module(f'stage{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))

        x = self.forward_head(x)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super(MLP, self).__init__()
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        hidden_features = hidden_features or in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class LayerScale(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, init_values=1e-05):
        super(LayerScale, self).__init__()
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(init_values * torch.ones(dim))

    def forward(self, x):
        return x * self.gamma

class Block(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, init_values=None):
        super(Block, self).__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, num_heads, dropout=attn_drop, batch_first=True)
        self.ls1 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.ls2 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.norm1(x)
        x = x + self.ls1(self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0])
        x = x + self.ls2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class Stem(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super(Stem, self).__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class VisionTransformer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, init_values=None, **kwargs):
        super(VisionTransformer, self).__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.patch_embed = Stem(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, init_values=init_values) for i in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0]
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def build_vit(**kwargs):
    model_args = dict(img_size=32, patch_size=8, embed_dim=32, depth=3, num_heads=2, init_values=1e-05)
    return VisionTransformer(**dict(model_args, **kwargs))
network = build_vit(num_classes=10)
example_input = torch.randn(1, 3, 32, 32)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor
from functools import partial

class SelfAttention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        hidden_features = hidden_features or in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.attn = SelfAttention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x))
        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class EncoderStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_dim, dim, depth, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, downsample=True):
        super().__init__()
        if downsample:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_dim, dim, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(dim))
        else:
            assert in_dim == dim
            self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[TransformerBlock(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.downsample(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)

class VisionTransformer(nn.Module):

        x = self.forward_head(x)

class Fire(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.squeeze_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.expand1x1_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        self.expand3x3_activation = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.squeeze_activation(self.sq(z))
        return torch.cat([self.expand1x1_activation(self.ex1(z)), self.expand3x3_activation(self.ex3(z))], 1)

    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
    layers = [nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)]
    if act:

    return nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer=None):

        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z):
        if self.use_res_connect:
            return z + self.conv(z)
        return self.conv(z)

    def __init__(self, stem_stages, main_stages, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None):

            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=1e-05)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = conv_bn(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2)

        for idx, (sq, e, n) in enumerate(stem_stages):

        for idx, (t, c, n, stride, se) in enumerate(main_stages, start=len(stem_stages)):
            blocks = []
            out_c = c
            for i in range(n):
                blocks.append(MBConv(in_ch, out_c, stride if i == 0 else 1, t, use_se=se))
                in_ch = out_c
            self.stages.append(nn.Sequential(*blocks))
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(1), nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate), nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes))

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from functools import partial

class ConvLayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, bias=False, **kwargs)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels, eps=0.001)

    def forward(self, z):
        z = self.conv(z)
        z = self.bn(z)
        return F.silu(z, inplace=True)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Hardsigmoid()

    def forward(self, z):
        scale = self.avgpool(z)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * z

class MBConv(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.has_skip = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup
        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(ConvLayer(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(ConvLayer(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SEBlock(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, z):
        out = self.conv(z)
        if self.has_skip:
            out = out + z
        return out

class ConvNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=1e-05)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.conv_stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)

        self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module='layer1'))
        self.layer2, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[1], in_ch)
        self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module='layer2'))
        self.layer3, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[2], in_ch)
        self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module='layer3'))
        self.layer4, in_ch = self._make_layer(*cfg[3], in_ch)
        self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module='layer4'))
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(1), nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate), nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes))

    def forward(self, z):
        torch._assert(z.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {z.dim()}D')
        z = self.conv_stem(z)
        z = self.bn1(z)
        z = self.act1(z)
        z = self.layer1(z)
        z = self.layer2(z)
        z = self.layer3(z)
        z = self.layer4(z)
        z = self.global_pool(z)
        return self.classifier(z)

        blocks = []
        out_c = c

            in_ch = out_c
        return (nn.Sequential(*blocks), in_ch)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from torchvision.ops import StochasticDepth

class ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

class CNBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0, layer_scale_init_value=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(dim, 4 * dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(self.pwconv1.out_channels, dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(layer_scale_init_value * torch.ones(dim)) if layer_scale_init_value > 0 else None
        self.drop_path = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, tensor):
        shortcut = tensor
        tensor = self.dwconv(tensor)
        tensor = self.norm(tensor)
        tensor = self.pwconv1(tensor)
        tensor = self.act(tensor)
        tensor = self.pwconv2(tensor)
        if self.gamma is not None:
            tensor = self.gamma.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1) * tensor
        tensor = shortcut + self.drop_path(tensor)
        return tensor

        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)

        for layer in self.layers:

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from functools import partial

class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x

def adjust_width(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)
    return int(round(width / group_width) * group_width)

class YBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.conv_a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU())
        self.conv_b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU())
        self.se = SqueezeExcitation(w_b, max(1, int(round(se_ratio * in_ch)))) if se_ratio else None
        self.conv_c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.shortcut = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x if self.shortcut is None else self.shortcut(x)
        x = self.conv_a(x)
        x = self.conv_b(x)
        if self.se is not None:
            x = self.se(x)
        x = self.conv_c(x)
        return self.act(x + shortcut)

class NormMlpHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

class Network(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, arch, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.conv_stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 8, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(8)
        self.act1 = nn.ReLU()
        in_ch = 8
        self.feature_info = []
        for idx, (w, d, g) in enumerate(arch):
            blocks = []
            w = adjust_width(w, g)
            for i in range(d):
                blocks.append(YBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g, se_ratio=0.5))
                in_ch = w
            self.add_module(f'stage{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stage{idx + 1}'))
        self.num_stages = len(arch)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.act_head = nn.ReLU()
        in_ch = 64
        self.head = NormMlpHead(in_ch, num_classes, drop_rate=drop_rate)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.conv_stem(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.act1(x)
        for i in range(self.num_stages):
            x = getattr(self, f'stage{i + 1}')(x)
        x = self.conv_head(x)
        x = self.act_head(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        return self.head(x, pre_logits=pre_logits)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from functools import partial

def _drop_path(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

class DropBlockPath(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, drop_prob=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob

    def forward(self, x):
        return _drop_path(x, self.drop_prob, self.training)

class Attention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        hidden_features = hidden_features or in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class LayerScale(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, init_values=1e-05):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(init_values * torch.ones(dim))

    def forward(self, x):
        return x * self.gamma

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, init_values=None, drop_path=0.0, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.attn = Attention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.ls1 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.ls2 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path1 = DropBlockPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = DropBlockPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.ls1(self.attn(self.norm1(x))))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.ls2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x))))
        return x

class PatchEmbed(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, init_values=None, drop_path_rate=0.1, global_pool='token', norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        norm_layer = norm_layer or partial(nn.LayerNorm, eps=1e-06)
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbed(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        dpr = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, depth)]
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TransformerBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, init_values=init_values, drop_path=dpr[i], norm_layer=norm_layer) for i in range(depth)])
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        x = torch.cat((self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1), x), dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def create_vit(**kwargs):
    model_args = dict(img_size=32, patch_size=4, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4)
    return PatchTransformer(**dict(model_args, **kwargs))

import torch.nn.functional as F

class BasicConv2d(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True) if act else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        return self.act(x)

class InvertedBottleneck(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.residual = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup
        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(BasicConv2d(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(BasicConv2d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.residual:
            out = out + x
        return out

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torchvision.ops import MLP
from functools import partial

class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super(MultiHeadAttention, self).__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm):
        super(EncoderBlock, self).__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.attn = MultiHeadAttention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, [hidden, dim], activation_layer=nn.GELU, dropout=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x))
        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class ViTStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_dim, dim, depth, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, downsample=True):
        super(ViTStage, self).__init__()
        if downsample:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_dim, dim, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(dim))
        else:
            assert in_dim == dim
            self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderBlock(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.downsample(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        return x

class TinyViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dims=(32, 64, 128), depths=(2, 2, 2), num_heads=(1, 2, 4), mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0):
        super(TinyViT, self).__init__()
        assert len(embed_dims) == len(depths) == len(num_heads)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dims[0] // 2, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(embed_dims[0] // 2), nn.GELU(), nn.Conv2d(embed_dims[0] // 2, embed_dims[0], kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1))
        stages = []
        in_dim = embed_dims[0]
        for i, (dim, depth, heads) in enumerate(zip(embed_dims, depths, num_heads)):
            stages.append(ViTStage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = embed_dims[-1]
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=(2, 3))
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def build_hvit(**kwargs):
    model_args = dict(embed_dims=(16, 32, 64), depths=(2, 2, 3), num_heads=(1, 1, 2), mlp_ratio=4.0)
    return TinyViT(**dict(model_args, **kwargs))

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super(MultiHeadAttention, self).__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

from typing import Callable, List, Optional
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor
from collections import OrderedDict
from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint_sequential

class SqueezeExpand(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):
        super().__init__()
        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.reduce = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_a = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.expand_b = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.hardswish(self.reduce(x))
        return torch.cat([F.hardswish(self.expand_a(x)), F.hardswish(self.expand_b(x))], 1)

def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False)

def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)

class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = conv1x1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3x3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c3 = conv1x1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        h = self.c1(x)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        h = self.c3(h)
        h = self.bn3(h)
        if self.proj is not None:
            residual = self.proj(x)
        h = h + residual
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        return h

class Model(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, cfg_a, cfg_b, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('conv', nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)), ('bn', nn.BatchNorm2d(16)), ('act', nn.Hardswish(inplace=True))]))
        in_ch = 16
        stages = OrderedDict()
        for idx, (sq, e, n) in enumerate(cfg_a):
            blocks = []
            if idx > 0:
                blocks.append(nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, ceil_mode=True))
            for _ in range(n):
                blocks.append(SqueezeExpand(in_ch, sq, e, e))
                in_ch = 2 * e
            stages[f'layer{idx + 1}'] = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        for idx, (planes, n, stride) in enumerate(cfg_b, start=len(cfg_a)):
            blocks = []
            downsample = None
            if stride != 1 or in_ch != planes * Bottleneck.expansion:
                downsample = nn.Sequential(conv1x1(in_ch, planes * Bottleneck.expansion, stride), nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * Bottleneck.expansion))
            blocks.append(Bottleneck(in_ch, planes, stride, downsample))
            in_ch = planes * Bottleneck.expansion
            for _ in range(1, n):
                blocks.append(Bottleneck(in_ch, planes))
            stages[f'layer{idx + 1}'] = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(stages)
        self.grad_checkpointing = False
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {x.dim()}D')
        x = self.stem(x)
        if self.grad_checkpointing and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
            x = checkpoint_sequential(self.stages, len(self.stages), x)
        else:
            x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean((2, 3))
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

class Bottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, proj=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = conv1x1(inplanes, planes)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c2 = conv3x3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.c3 = conv1x1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(planes * self.expansion)
        self.proj = proj
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        h = self.c1(x)
        h = self.bn1(h)
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        h = self.c2(h)
        h = self.bn2(h)
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        h = self.c3(h)
        h = self.bn3(h)
        if self.proj is not None:
            residual = self.proj(x)
        h = h + residual
        h = F.hardswish(h)
        return h

from functools import partial

class SELayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x

def round_width(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)
    return int(round(width / group_width) * group_width)

class ResBottleneckBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.conv_a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.Hardswish(inplace=True))
        self.conv_b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.Hardswish(inplace=True))
        self.se = SELayer(w_b, max(1, int(round(se_ratio * in_ch)))) if se_ratio else None
        self.conv_c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.downsample = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x if self.downsample is None else self.downsample(x)
        x = self.conv_a(x)
        x = self.conv_b(x)
        if self.se is not None:
            x = self.se(x)
        x = self.conv_c(x)
        return self.act(x + shortcut)

class FireModule(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inplanes, squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, expand3x3_planes):

        self.inplanes = inplanes
        self.sq = nn.Conv2d(inplanes, squeeze_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex1 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand1x1_planes, kernel_size=1)
        self.ex3 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_planes, expand3x3_planes, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):

        return torch.cat([self.act(self.ex1(x)), self.act(self.ex3(x))], 1)

        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pool(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):

        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean((2, 3), keepdim=True)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

class Net(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, early_cfg, late_cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = ConvStem(in_chans, 16, norm_layer=norm_layer)
        in_ch = 16
        self.feature_info = []
        for idx, (w, d, g) in enumerate(early_cfg):
            blocks = []
            w = round_width(w, g)
            for i in range(d):
                blocks.append(ResBottleneckBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g, se_ratio=0.25))
                in_ch = w
            self.add_module(f'layer{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'layer{idx + 1}'))
        for idx, (sq, e, n) in enumerate(late_cfg, start=len(early_cfg)):

        x = self.act_head(x)
        return x

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def adjust_width(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)

class RegNetBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.conv_a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.SiLU(inplace=True))
        self.conv_b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.SiLU(inplace=True))
        self.se = None
        self.conv_c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.downsample = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, input):
        shortcut = input if self.downsample is None else self.downsample(input)
        input = self.conv_a(input)
        input = self.conv_b(input)
        if self.se is not None:
            input = self.se(input)
        input = self.conv_c(input)
        return self.act(input + shortcut)

class BlockStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, w, d, g, in_ch):
        super().__init__()
        blocks = []
        w = adjust_width(w, g)
        for i in range(d):
            blocks.append(RegNetBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g))
            in_ch = w
        self.layers = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.out_channels = in_ch

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.layers(x)

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):

        if norm_layer is None:

        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.conv_stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)

        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.conv_head = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.act_head = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        in_ch = 64

        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

        input = self.bn1(input)
        input = self.act1(input)
        input = self.stages(input)
        input = self.conv_head(input)
        input = self.act_head(input)

import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn

from functools import partial

class _DenseLayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, inp):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(inp)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out

class DenseStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([_DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)])

    def forward(self, inp):
        features = [inp]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)

class Transition(nn.Sequential):

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, num_output_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, num_output_features, kernel_size=1, stride=1, bias=False)
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)

class StemBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pool(x)
        return x

class NormMlpHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean((2, 3), keepdim=True)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def __init__(self, settings, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, output_stride=32):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = StemBlock(in_chans, 16, norm_layer=norm_layer)
        in_ch = 16
        self.layer1, in_ch = self._make_stage(*settings[0], in_ch, last=False)
        self.layer2, in_ch = self._make_stage(*settings[1], in_ch, last=False)
        self.layer3, in_ch = self._make_stage(*settings[2], in_ch, last=False)
        self.layer4, in_ch = self._make_stage(*settings[3], in_ch, last=True)
        self.head = NormMlpHead(in_ch, num_classes, drop_rate=drop_rate)

    def forward(self, inp):
        torch._assert(inp.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {inp.dim()}D')
        inp = self.stem(inp)
        inp = self.layer1(inp)
        inp = self.layer2(inp)
        inp = self.layer3(inp)
        inp = self.layer4(inp)
        return self.head(inp)

    @staticmethod
    def _make_stage(n, in_ch, last=False):
        blocks = []
        blocks.append(DenseStage(n, in_ch, 4, 8))
        in_ch = in_ch + n * 8
        if not last:
            blocks.append(Transition(in_ch, in_ch // 2))
            in_ch = in_ch // 2
        return (nn.Sequential(*blocks), in_ch)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint_sequential

class FeedForward(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if out_features is None:
            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class Block(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, num_heads, dropout=attn_drop, batch_first=True)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(dim, hidden, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.norm1(x)
        x = x + self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0]
        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class PatchEmbedding(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer is not None else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbedding(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[Block(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate) for i in range(depth)])
        self.grad_checkpointing = False
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        if self.grad_checkpointing and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
            x = checkpoint_sequential(self.blocks, len(self.blocks), x)
        else:
            x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def adjust_width(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)
    return int(round(width / group_width) * group_width)

class XBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.conv_a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU())
        self.conv_b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU())
        self.se = None
        self.conv_c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.proj = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.ReLU()

        x = self.conv_a(x)

        if self.se is not None:
            x = self.se(x)
        x = self.conv_c(x)
        return self.act(x + shortcut)

class TinyNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, settings, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('conv', nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)), ('bn', nn.BatchNorm2d(16)), ('act', nn.ReLU())]))
        in_ch = 16
        blocks = []
        for idx, (w, d, g) in enumerate(settings):
            w = adjust_width(w, g)
            for i in range(d):
                blocks.append(XBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g))
                in_ch = w
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward_features(self, x):

        x = x.mean((-2, -1))
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)

class DenseUnit(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super(DenseUnit, self).__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.norm2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(bn_size * growth_rate)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu(self.norm1(tensor)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu(self.norm2(out)))
        return out

class DenseStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super(DenseStage, self).__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([DenseUnit(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)])

    def forward(self, tensor):
        features = [tensor]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(features, 1))
            features.append(new)
        return torch.cat(features, 1)

        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, tensor):

        tensor = self.bn(tensor)

    def __init__(self, stage_cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):

        tensor = self.layer4(tensor)
        tensor = self.layer5(tensor)
