    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, init_values=None, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = SelfAttention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.ls1 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.ls2 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path1 = DropBlockPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = DropBlockPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.ls1(self.attn(self.norm1(x))))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.ls2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x))))
        return x

class Stage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_dim, dim, depth, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, downsample=True):
        super().__init__()
        if downsample:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_dim, dim, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(dim))
        else:
            assert in_dim == dim
            self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[TransformerBlock(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.downsample(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        return x

class PatchTransformer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dims=(32, 64, 128), depths=(2, 2, 2), num_heads=(1, 2, 4), mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert len(embed_dims) == len(depths) == len(num_heads)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dims[0] // 2, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(embed_dims[0] // 2), nn.GELU(), nn.Conv2d(embed_dims[0] // 2, embed_dims[0], kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1))
        stages = []
        in_dim = embed_dims[0]
        for i, (dim, depth, heads) in enumerate(zip(embed_dims, depths, num_heads)):
            stages.append(Stage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = embed_dims[-1]
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=(2, 3))
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    batchsize, num_channels, height, width = x.size()
    channels_per_group = num_channels // groups
    x = x.view(batchsize, groups, channels_per_group, height, width)
    x = torch.transpose(x, 1, 2).contiguous()
    x = x.view(batchsize, -1, height, width)
    return x

class ShuffleUnit(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride):
        super().__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        branch_features = oup // 2
        if self.stride > 1:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(inp, inp, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=inp, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(inp), nn.Conv2d(inp, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        else:
            self.branch1 = nn.Sequential()
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(inp if self.stride > 1 else branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features), nn.ReLU(inplace=True), nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=3, stride=self.stride, padding=1, groups=branch_features, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features), nn.Conv2d(branch_features, branch_features, kernel_size=1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(branch_features), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))

    def forward(self, x):
        if self.stride == 1:
            x1, x2 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
            out = torch.cat((x1, self.branch2(x2)), dim=1)
        else:
            out = torch.cat((self.branch1(x), self.branch2(x)), dim=1)
        out = channel_shuffle(out, 2)
        return out

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        return x

class Model(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, stage_cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = StemBlock(in_chans, 8, norm_layer=norm_layer)
        in_ch = 8
        self.feature_info = []
        stages = OrderedDict()
        for idx, (c, n) in enumerate(stage_cfg):
            blocks = []
            blocks.append(ShuffleUnit(in_ch, c, 2))
            for _ in range(n - 1):
                blocks.append(ShuffleUnit(c, c, 1))
            in_ch = c
            stages[f'block{idx + 1}'] = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stages.block{idx + 1}'))
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(stages)
        self.grad_checkpointing = False
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.act_head = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)

        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

        else:

        x = x.mean((-2, -1))
        x = x.flatten(1)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

class Mlp(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        hidden_features = hidden_features or in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, num_heads, dropout=attn_drop, batch_first=True)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = Mlp(dim, hidden, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.norm1(x)
        x = x + self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0]
        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class PatchEmbedding(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class TinyViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, global_pool='token', **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbedding(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate) for i in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, dim, init_values=1e-05):

    def forward(self, x):

        self.drop_path2 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, init_values=None, drop_path_rate=0.1, global_pool='token', norm_layer=None, **kwargs):

        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))

        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

class LinearBottleneck(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, stride, dilation=(1, 1), exp_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=0.0, ch_div=1, act_layer='swish', dw_act_layer='relu6', drop_path=None, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.use_shortcut = stride == 1 and dilation[0] == dilation[1] and (in_chs <= out_chs)
        self.in_channels = in_chs
        self.out_channels = out_chs
        if exp_ratio != 1.0:
            dw_chs = make_divisible(round(in_chs * exp_ratio), divisor=ch_div)
            self.conv_exp = ConvNormAct(in_chs, dw_chs, act_layer=act_layer, **dd)
        else:
            dw_chs = in_chs
            self.conv_exp = None
        self.conv_dw = ConvNormAct(dw_chs, dw_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, dilation=dilation[0], groups=dw_chs, apply_act=False, **dd)
        if se_ratio > 0:
            self.se = SEWithNorm(dw_chs, rd_channels=make_divisible(int(dw_chs * se_ratio), ch_div), **dd)
        else:

        self.conv_pwl = ConvNormAct(dw_chs, out_chs, 1, apply_act=False, **dd)

    def feat_channels(self, exp=False):

    def forward(self, x):

            x = self.conv_exp(x)
        x = self.conv_dw(x)
        if self.se is not None:
            x = self.se(x)
        x = self.act_dw(x)
        x = self.conv_pwl(x)
        if self.use_shortcut:
            if self.drop_path is not None:
                x = self.drop_path(x)
            x = torch.cat([x[:, 0:self.in_channels] + shortcut, x[:, self.in_channels:]], dim=1)

def _block_cfg(width_mult=1.0, depth_mult=1.0, initial_chs=16, final_chs=180, se_ratio=0.0, ch_div=1):
    layers = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 5]
    strides = [1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2]
    layers = [ceil(element * depth_mult) for element in layers]
    strides = sum([[element] + [1] * (layers[idx] - 1) for idx, element in enumerate(strides)], [])
    exp_ratios = [1] * layers[0] + [6] * sum(layers[1:])
    depth = sum(layers[:]) * 3
    base_chs = initial_chs / width_mult if width_mult < 1.0 else initial_chs
    out_chs_list = []
    for i in range(depth // 3):
        out_chs_list.append(make_divisible(round(base_chs * width_mult), divisor=ch_div))
        base_chs += final_chs / (depth // 3 * 1.0)
    se_ratios = [0.0] * (layers[0] + layers[1]) + [se_ratio] * sum(layers[2:])
    return list(zip(out_chs_list, exp_ratios, strides, se_ratios))

    dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
    feat_chs = [prev_chs]
    feature_info = []
    curr_stride = 2
    dilation = 1
    features = []
    num_blocks = len(block_cfg)
    for block_idx, (chs, exp_ratio, stride, se_ratio) in enumerate(block_cfg):
        next_dilation = dilation
        if stride > 1:
            fname = 'stem' if block_idx == 0 else f'features.{block_idx - 1}'
            feature_info += [dict(num_chs=feat_chs[-1], reduction=curr_stride, module=fname)]
            if curr_stride >= output_stride:
                next_dilation = dilation * stride
                stride = 1
        block_dpr = drop_path_rate * block_idx / (num_blocks - 1)
        drop_path = DropPath(block_dpr) if block_dpr > 0.0 else None
        features.append(LinearBottleneck(in_chs=prev_chs, out_chs=chs, exp_ratio=exp_ratio, stride=stride, dilation=(dilation, next_dilation), se_ratio=se_ratio, ch_div=ch_div, act_layer=act_layer, dw_act_layer=dw_act_layer, drop_path=drop_path, **dd))
        curr_stride *= stride

def conv_bn(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor
from collections import OrderedDict

class ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

def _drop_path(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

class DropPath(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, drop_prob=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob

    def forward(self, x):
        return _drop_path(x, self.drop_prob, self.training)

class ConvNeXtBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0, layer_scale_init_value=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(dim, 4 * dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(self.pwconv1.out_channels, dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(layer_scale_init_value * torch.ones(dim)) if layer_scale_init_value > 0 else None
        self.drop_path = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, feats):
        shortcut = feats
        feats = self.dwconv(feats)
        feats = self.norm(feats)
        feats = self.pwconv1(feats)
        feats = self.act(feats)
        feats = self.pwconv2(feats)
        if self.gamma is not None:
            feats = self.gamma.reshape(1, -1, 1, 1) * feats
        feats = shortcut + self.drop_path(feats)
        return feats

class Classifier(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, settings, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, output_stride=32):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 8, kernel_size=4, stride=4), ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(8, eps=1e-06))
        in_ch = 8
        total = sum((r[1] for r in settings))
        dp_rates = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, total)]
        cur = 0
        self.feature_info = []
        stages = OrderedDict()
        for idx, (dim, n) in enumerate(settings):
            blocks = []
            if in_ch != dim:
                blocks.append(nn.Sequential(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(in_ch, eps=1e-06), nn.Conv2d(in_ch, dim, kernel_size=2, stride=2)))
            for j in range(n):
                blocks.append(ConvNeXtBlock(dim, drop_path=dp_rates[cur + j]))
            cur += n
            in_ch = dim
            stages[f'layer{idx + 1}'] = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stages.layer{idx + 1}'))
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(stages)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.act_head = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        in_ch = 64
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(1), nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate), nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes))

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.stem(feats)
        feats = self.stages(feats)
        feats = self.conv_head(feats)
        feats = self.act_head(feats)
        feats = self.global_pool(feats)
        return self.classifier(feats)

def _classifier(variant, weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    cfgs = {'small': [(16, 1), (32, 2), (64, 1), (128, 1)], 'base': [(16, 2), (32, 3), (64, 2), (128, 2)]}
    model = Classifier(cfgs[variant], **kwargs)
    if weights is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(weights.get_state_dict(progress=progress))
    return model

def make_model(weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    return _classifier('base', weights, progress, **kwargs)

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))

        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)

        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]

from torchvision.ops import Conv2dNormActivation

def conv3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False)

def conv1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)

class ResBottleneck(nn.Module):
    expansion = 4

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv1 = conv1(inplanes, planes)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv2 = conv3(planes, planes, stride)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv3 = conv1(planes, planes * self.expansion)
        self.norm3 = norm_layer(planes * self.expansion)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, feats):
        skip_val = feats
        h = self.conv1(feats)
        h = self.norm1(h)
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.conv2(h)
        h = self.norm2(h)
        h = F.relu(h)
        h = self.conv3(h)
        h = self.norm3(h)
        if self.skip is not None:
            skip_val = self.skip(feats)
        h += skip_val
        h = F.relu(h)
        return h

def downsample_conv(in_chs, out_chs, stride=1, norm_layer=None):
    if norm_layer is None:
        norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
    return nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False), norm_layer(out_chs))

def downsample_avg(in_chs, out_chs, stride=1, norm_layer=None):
    if norm_layer is None:
        norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
    pool = nn.AvgPool2d(2, stride, ceil_mode=True, count_include_pad=False) if stride > 1 else nn.Identity()
    return nn.Sequential(pool, nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=1, stride=1, bias=False), norm_layer(out_chs))

class ConvBNActivation(nn.Sequential):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
        layers = [nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride, padding, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)]
        if act:
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
        super().__init__(*layers)

class ConvNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, block, settings, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, down_type='conv'):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = ConvBNActivation(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        in_ch = 16
        self.feature_info = []
        blocks = []
        for idx, (planes, n, stride) in enumerate(settings):
            downsample = None
            if stride != 1 or in_ch != planes * block.expansion:
                down_fn = downsample_avg if down_type == 'avg' else downsample_conv
                downsample = down_fn(in_ch, planes * block.expansion, stride, norm_layer)
            blocks.append(block(in_ch, planes, stride, downsample))
            in_ch = planes * block.expansion
            for _ in range(1, n):
                blocks.append(block(in_ch, planes))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'features.{len(blocks) - 1}'))
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = Conv2dNormActivation(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1)
        in_ch = 64
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward_features(self, feats):
        torch._assert(feats.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {feats.dim()}D')
        feats = self.stem(feats)
        feats = self.features(feats)
        feats = self.conv_head(feats)
        return feats

    def forward_head(self, feats, pre_logits=False):
        feats = self.global_pool(feats)
        feats = feats.flatten(1)
        feats = self.drop(feats)
        return feats if pre_logits else self.fc(feats)

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.forward_features(feats)
        feats = self.forward_head(feats)
        return feats

    layers = [nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.Hardswish(inplace=True))

        self.branch3_1 = conv_bn_act(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)

        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from collections import OrderedDict

class ConvNormAct(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.use_act = act
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.conv(inp)
        inp = self.bn(inp)
        if self.use_act:
            inp = self.act(inp)
        return inp

class MixedBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, pool_features, conv_block=None):
        super().__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = ConvNormAct
        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3))
        self.branch_b_3 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(3, 1))
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, inp):
        br1 = self.branch_a(inp)
        y2 = self.branch_b_1(inp)
        y2 = self.branch_b_2(y2)
        y2 = self.branch_b_3(y2)
        bp = F.max_pool2d(inp, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [br1, y2, bp]

    def forward(self, inp):
        outputs = self._forward(inp)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

class Model(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, output_stride=32, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('conv', nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)), ('bn', norm_layer(16)), ('act', nn.SiLU(inplace=True))]))
        in_ch = 16
        self.mixed_1 = MixedBlock(in_ch, 8, 12, 16)
        in_ch = 36
        self.mixed_2 = MixedBlock(in_ch, 12, 16, 16)
        in_ch = 44
        self.mixed_3 = MixedBlock(in_ch, 24, 24, 16)
        in_ch = 64
        self.mixed_4 = MixedBlock(in_ch, 24, 16, 8)
        in_ch = 48
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.drop = nn.Identity()
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward_features(self, inp):
        inp = self.stem(inp)
        inp = self.mixed_1(inp)
        inp = self.mixed_2(inp)
        inp = F.max_pool2d(inp, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        inp = self.mixed_3(inp)
        inp = F.max_pool2d(inp, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
        inp = self.mixed_4(inp)
        return inp

    def forward_head(self, inp, pre_logits=False):
        inp = self.global_pool(inp)
        inp = inp.flatten(1)
        inp = self.drop(inp)
        return inp if pre_logits else self.fc(inp)

    def forward(self, inp):
        inp = self.forward_features(inp)
        inp = self.forward_head(inp)
        return inp

def create_net(**kwargs):
    return Model(**kwargs)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor

class ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm, self).__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

def _drop_path(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

class DropPath(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, drop_prob=None):
        super(DropPath, self).__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob

    def forward(self, x):
        return _drop_path(x, self.drop_prob, self.training)

class DepthwiseMLPBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0):
        super(DepthwiseMLPBlock, self).__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(dim, 2 * dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(self.pwconv1.out_channels, dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.drop_path = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x
        x = self.dwconv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.pwconv1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pwconv2(x)
        x = shortcut + self.drop_path(x)
        return x

class ClassifierHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super(ClassifierHead, self).__init__()
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

class ConvNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1):
        super(ConvNet, self).__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4), ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(16, eps=1e-06))
        in_ch = 16
        total = sum((r[1] for r in cfg))
        dp_rates = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, total)]
        cur = 0
        self.feature_info = []
        self.stages = nn.ModuleList()
        for idx, (dim, n) in enumerate(cfg):
            blocks = []
            if in_ch != dim:
                blocks.append(nn.Sequential(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(in_ch, eps=1e-06), nn.Conv2d(in_ch, dim, kernel_size=2, stride=2)))
            for j in range(n):
                blocks.append(DepthwiseMLPBlock(dim, drop_path=dp_rates[cur + j]))
            cur += n
            in_ch = dim
            self.stages.append(nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stages.{idx}'))
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, 64, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.act_head = nn.ReLU6()
        in_ch = 64
        self.head = ClassifierHead(in_ch, num_classes, drop_rate=drop_rate)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        for stage in self.stages:
            x = stage(x)
        x = self.conv_head(x)
        x = self.act_head(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        return self.head(x, pre_logits=pre_logits)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

    return ConvNet(cfgs[variant], **kwargs)

class PositionalEncodingFourier(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, hidden_dim=32, dim=768, temperature=10000, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()

        self.scale = 2 * math.pi
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        self.dim = dim
        self.eps = 1e-06

    def forward(self, B, H, W):
        device = self.token_projection.weight.device
        dtype = self.token_projection.weight.dtype
        y_embed = torch.arange(1, H + 1, device=device).to(torch.float32).unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, 1, W)

        y_embed = y_embed / (y_embed[:, -1:, :] + self.eps) * self.scale
        x_embed = x_embed / (x_embed[:, :, -1:] + self.eps) * self.scale
        dim_t = torch.arange(self.hidden_dim, device=device).to(torch.float32)

        pos_y = torch.stack([pos_y[:, :, :, 0::2].sin(), pos_y[:, :, :, 1::2].cos()], dim=4).flatten(3)
        pos = torch.cat((pos_y, pos_x), dim=3).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        pos = self.token_projection(pos.to(dtype))
        return pos.repeat(B, 1, 1, 1)

def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, device=None, dtype=None):
    dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
    return torch.nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, bias=False, **dd), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_planes, **dd))

class ConvPatchEmbed(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=224, patch_size=16, in_chans=3, embed_dim=768, act_layer=nn.GELU, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        img_size = to_2tuple(img_size)
        num_patches = img_size[1] // patch_size * (img_size[0] // patch_size)
        self.img_size = img_size
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.num_patches = num_patches
        if patch_size == 16:
            self.proj = torch.nn.Sequential(conv3x3(in_chans, embed_dim // 8, 2, **dd), act_layer(), conv3x3(embed_dim // 8, embed_dim // 4, 2, **dd), act_layer(), conv3x3(embed_dim // 4, embed_dim // 2, 2, **dd), act_layer(), conv3x3(embed_dim // 2, embed_dim, 2, **dd))
        elif patch_size == 8:
            self.proj = torch.nn.Sequential(conv3x3(in_chans, embed_dim // 4, 2, **dd), act_layer(), conv3x3(embed_dim // 4, embed_dim // 2, 2, **dd), act_layer(), conv3x3(embed_dim // 2, embed_dim, 2, **dd))
        else:
            raise 'For convolutional projection, patch size has to be in [8, 16]'

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        Hp, Wp = (x.shape[2], x.shape[3])
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        return (x, (Hp, Wp))

class LPI(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, kernel_size=3, device=None, dtype=None):
        super().__init__()
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        padding = kernel_size // 2
        self.conv1 = torch.nn.Conv2d(in_features, in_features, kernel_size=kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=in_features, **dd)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm2d(in_features, **dd)
        self.conv2 = torch.nn.Conv2d(in_features, out_features, kernel_size=kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=out_features, **dd)

    def forward(self, x, H, W):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = x.reshape(B, C, N).permute(0, 2, 1)
        return x

class ClassAttentionBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, proj_drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0, act_layer=nn.GELU, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm, eta=1.0, tokens_norm=False, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        self.attn = ClassAttn(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=proj_drop, **dd)
        self.drop_path1 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        self.mlp = Mlp(in_features=dim, hidden_features=int(dim * mlp_ratio), act_layer=act_layer, drop=proj_drop, **dd)
        self.drop_path2 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        if eta is not None:
            self.gamma1 = nn.Parameter(eta * torch.ones(dim, **dd))
            self.gamma2 = nn.Parameter(eta * torch.ones(dim, **dd))
        else:
            self.gamma1, self.gamma2 = (1.0, 1.0)
        self.tokens_norm = tokens_norm

    def forward(self, x):
        x_norm1 = self.norm1(x)
        x_attn = torch.cat([self.attn(x_norm1), x_norm1[:, 1:]], dim=1)
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.gamma1 * x_attn)
        if self.tokens_norm:
            x = self.norm2(x)
        else:
            x = torch.cat([self.norm2(x[:, 0:1]), x[:, 1:]], dim=1)
        x_res = x
        cls_token = x[:, 0:1]
        cls_token = self.gamma2 * self.mlp(cls_token)
        x = torch.cat([cls_token, x[:, 1:]], dim=1)
        x = x_res + self.drop_path2(x)
        return x

class XCA(nn.Module):
    """ Cross-Covariance Attention (XCA)
    Operation where the channels are updated using a weighted sum. The weights are obtained from the (softmax
    normalized) Cross-covariance matrix (Q^T \\cdot K \\in d_h \\times d_h)
    """

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.fused_attn = use_fused_attn(experimental=True)
        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_heads, 1, 1, **dd))
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias, **dd)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim, **dd)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, C // self.num_heads).permute(2, 0, 3, 4, 1)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        if self.fused_attn:
            q = torch.nn.functional.normalize(q, dim=-1) * self.temperature
            k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(k, dim=-1)
            x = torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, scale=1.0)
        else:
            q = torch.nn.functional.normalize(q, dim=-1)
            k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(k, dim=-1)
            attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.temperature
            attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
            attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
            x = attn @ v
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class XCABlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, proj_drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0, act_layer=nn.GELU, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm, eta=1.0, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        self.attn = XCA(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=proj_drop, **dd)
        self.drop_path1 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.norm3 = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        self.local_mp = LPI(in_features=dim, act_layer=act_layer, **dd)
        self.drop_path3 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim, **dd)
        self.mlp = Mlp(in_features=dim, hidden_features=int(dim * mlp_ratio), act_layer=act_layer, drop=proj_drop, **dd)
        self.drop_path2 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.gamma1 = nn.Parameter(eta * torch.ones(dim, **dd))
        self.gamma3 = nn.Parameter(eta * torch.ones(dim, **dd))
        self.gamma2 = nn.Parameter(eta * torch.ones(dim, **dd))

    def forward(self, x, H, W):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.gamma1 * self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.drop_path3(self.gamma3 * self.local_mp(self.norm3(x), H, W))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.gamma2 * self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class Xcit(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=224, patch_size=16, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, global_pool='token', embed_dim=768, depth=12, num_heads=12, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, pos_drop_rate=0.0, proj_drop_rate=0.0, attn_drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.0, act_layer=None, norm_layer=None, cls_attn_layers=2, use_pos_embed=True, eta=1.0, tokens_norm=False, device=None, dtype=None):
        super().__init__()
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        assert global_pool in ('', 'avg', 'token'), 'Only avg or token pooling (or none) is supported.'
        img_size = to_2tuple(img_size)
        assert img_size[0] % patch_size == 0 and img_size[0] % patch_size == 0, '`patch_size` should divide image dimensions evenly'
        norm_layer = norm_layer or partial(nn.LayerNorm, eps=1e-06)
        act_layer = act_layer or nn.GELU
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.in_chans = in_chans
        self.num_features = self.head_hidden_size = self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.grad_checkpointing = False
        self.patch_embed = ConvPatchEmbed(img_size=img_size, patch_size=patch_size, in_chans=in_chans, embed_dim=embed_dim, act_layer=act_layer, **dd)
        r = patch_size
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim, **dd))
        self.num_prefix_tokens = 1
        if use_pos_embed:
            self.pos_embed = PositionalEncodingFourier(dim=embed_dim, **dd)
        else:
            self.pos_embed = None
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=pos_drop_rate)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([XCABlock(dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, proj_drop=proj_drop_rate, attn_drop=attn_drop_rate, drop_path=drop_path_rate, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, eta=eta, **dd) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.feature_info = [dict(num_chs=embed_dim, reduction=r, module=f'blocks.{i}') for i in range(depth)]
        self.cls_attn_blocks = nn.ModuleList([ClassAttentionBlock(dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, proj_drop=proj_drop_rate, attn_drop=attn_drop_rate, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer=norm_layer, eta=eta, tokens_norm=tokens_norm, **dd) for _ in range(cls_attn_layers)])
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim, **dd)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes, **dd) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        B = x.shape[0]
        x, (Hp, Wp) = self.patch_embed(x)
        if self.pos_embed is not None:
            pos_encoding = self.pos_embed(B, Hp, Wp).reshape(B, -1, x.shape[1]).permute(0, 2, 1)
            x = x + pos_encoding
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            if self.grad_checkpointing and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
                x = checkpoint(blk, x, Hp, Wp)
            else:
                x = blk(x, Hp, Wp)
        if self.cls_attn_blocks is not None:
            x = self.forward_cls(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_cls(self, x):
        x = torch.cat((self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1), x), dim=1)
        for blk in self.cls_attn_blocks:
            if self.grad_checkpointing and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
                x = checkpoint(blk, x)
            else:
                x = blk(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        if self.global_pool:
            x = x[:, self.num_prefix_tokens:].mean(dim=1) if self.global_pool == 'avg' else x[:, 0]
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def checkpoint_filter_fn(state_dict, model):
    if 'model' in state_dict:
        state_dict = state_dict['model']
    use_pos_embed = getattr(model, 'pos_embed', None) is not None
    pos_embed_keys = [k for k in state_dict if k.startswith('pos_embed')]
    for k in pos_embed_keys:
        if use_pos_embed:
            state_dict[k.replace('pos_embeder.', 'pos_embed.')] = state_dict.pop(k)
        else:
            del state_dict[k]
    if 'cls_attn_blocks.0.attn.qkv.weight' in state_dict and 'cls_attn_blocks.0.attn.q.weight' in model.state_dict():
        num_ca_blocks = len(model.cls_attn_blocks)
        for i in range(num_ca_blocks):
            qkv_weight = state_dict.pop(f'cls_attn_blocks.{i}.attn.qkv.weight')
            qkv_weight = qkv_weight.reshape(3, -1, qkv_weight.shape[-1])
            for j, subscript in enumerate('qkv'):
                state_dict[f'cls_attn_blocks.{i}.attn.{subscript}.weight'] = qkv_weight[j]
            qkv_bias = state_dict.pop(f'cls_attn_blocks.{i}.attn.qkv.bias', None)
            if qkv_bias is not None:
                qkv_bias = qkv_bias.reshape(3, -1)
                for j, subscript in enumerate('qkv'):
                    state_dict[f'cls_attn_blocks.{i}.attn.{subscript}.bias'] = qkv_bias[j]
    return state_dict

class PositionalEncodingFourier(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, hidden_dim=32, dim=768, temperature=10000, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.token_projection = nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim * 2, dim, kernel_size=1, **dd)
        self.scale = 2 * math.pi
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        self.dim = dim
        self.eps = 1e-06

    def forward(self, B, H, W):
        device = self.token_projection.weight.device
        dtype = self.token_projection.weight.dtype
        y_embed = torch.arange(1, H + 1, device=device).to(torch.float32).unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, 1, W)
        x_embed = torch.arange(1, W + 1, device=device).to(torch.float32).repeat(1, H, 1)
        y_embed = y_embed / (y_embed[:, -1:, :] + self.eps) * self.scale
        x_embed = x_embed / (x_embed[:, :, -1:] + self.eps) * self.scale
        dim_t = torch.arange(self.hidden_dim, device=device).to(torch.float32)
        dim_t = self.temperature ** (2 * torch.div(dim_t, 2, rounding_mode='floor') / self.hidden_dim)
        pos_x = x_embed[:, :, :, None] / dim_t
        pos_y = y_embed[:, :, :, None] / dim_t
        pos_x = torch.stack([pos_x[:, :, :, 0::2].sin(), pos_x[:, :, :, 1::2].cos()], dim=4).flatten(3)
        pos_y = torch.stack([pos_y[:, :, :, 0::2].sin(), pos_y[:, :, :, 1::2].cos()], dim=4).flatten(3)
        pos = torch.cat((pos_y, pos_x), dim=3).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        pos = self.token_projection(pos.to(dtype))
        return pos.repeat(B, 1, 1, 1)

from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional
import torch
from torch import Tensor, nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class MlpBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features, act_layer=None, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if act_layer is None:
            act_layer = nn.GELU
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, in_features)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x

class MixerLayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, seq_len, mlp_ratio=(0.5, 4.0), drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        tokens_dim, channels_dim = [int(r * dim) for r in mlp_ratio]
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp_tokens = MlpBlock(seq_len, tokens_dim, drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp_channels = MlpBlock(dim, channels_dim, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.mlp_tokens(self.norm1(x).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.mlp_channels(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class TinyMixer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_classes=10, img_size=32, in_chans=3, patch_size=4, num_blocks=4, embed_dim=64, mlp_ratio=(0.5, 4.0), drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.0, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[MixerLayer(embed_dim, num_patches, mlp_ratio, drop=drop_rate) for i in range(num_blocks)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)

def _quantize(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)
    return int(round(width / group_width) * group_width)

class XBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.f_a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.SiLU(inplace=True))
        self.f_b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.SiLU(inplace=True))
        self.se = None
        self.f_c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.proj = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)

        x = self.f_a(x)
        x = self.f_b(x)
        if self.se is not None:
            x = self.se(x)
        x = self.f_c(x)
        return self.act(x + shortcut)

        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.conv_stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 8, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = norm_layer(8)
        self.act1 = nn.SiLU(inplace=True)
        in_ch = 8
        for idx, (w, d, g) in enumerate(cfg):
            blocks = []
            w = _quantize(w, g)
            for i in range(d):
                blocks.append(XBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g))
                in_ch = w
            self.add_module(f'stage{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
        self.num_stages = len(cfg)
        self.conv_head = Conv2dNormActivation(in_ch, 128, kernel_size=1)
        in_ch = 128
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.drop = nn.Identity()
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

        x = self.conv_stem(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.act1(x)
        for i in range(self.num_stages):

        x = self.conv_head(x)

        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def conv_bn_relu(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
    layers = [nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)

class InceptionA(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, conv_block=None):
        super(InceptionA, self).__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = conv_bn_relu
        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=3)
        self.branch_c_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2 = conv_block(ch3, ch3 * 2, kernel_size=(1, 3))

    def _forward(self, inp):
        b1 = self.branch_a(inp)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(inp)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        br3 = self.branch_c_1(inp)
        br3 = self.branch_c_2(br3)
        return [b1, b2, br3]

    def forward(self, inp):
        outputs = self._forward(inp)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)

        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pool(x)
        return x

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor
from torchvision.ops import StochasticDepth

class ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm, self).__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

class ConvNeXtBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0, layer_scale_init_value=1e-06):
        super(ConvNeXtBlock, self).__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Linear(dim, 2 * dim)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Linear(self.pwconv1.out_features, dim)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(layer_scale_init_value * torch.ones(dim)) if layer_scale_init_value > 0 else None
        self.drop_path = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        shortcut = x
        x = self.dwconv(x)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.pwconv1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pwconv2(x)
        if self.gamma is not None:
            x = self.gamma * x
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        x = shortcut + self.drop_path(x)
        return x

class Net(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, stage_cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, output_stride=32, **kwargs):
        super(Net, self).__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4), ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(16, eps=1e-06))
        in_ch = 16
        total = sum((r[1] for r in stage_cfg))
        dp_rates = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, total)]
        cur = 0
        self.feature_info = []
        for idx, (dim, n) in enumerate(stage_cfg):
            blocks = []
            if in_ch != dim:
                blocks.append(nn.Sequential(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(in_ch, eps=1e-06), nn.Conv2d(in_ch, dim, kernel_size=2, stride=2)))
            for j in range(n):
                blocks.append(ConvNeXtBlock(dim, drop_path=dp_rates[cur + j]))
            cur += n
            in_ch = dim
            self.add_module(f'layer{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'layer{idx + 1}'))
        self.num_stages = len(stage_cfg)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Identity()
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        for i in range(self.num_stages):
            x = getattr(self, f'layer{i + 1}')(x)
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return self.fc(x)

def _net(variant, weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    cfgs = {'small': [(16, 2), (32, 2), (64, 2)], 'base': [(16, 3), (32, 3), (64, 3)]}
    model = Net(cfgs[variant], **kwargs)
    if weights is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(weights.get_state_dict(progress=progress))
    return model

def make_model(weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    return _net('base', weights, progress, **kwargs)

class ChannelsFirstLayerNorm(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super(ChannelsFirstLayerNorm, self).__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torchvision.ops import StochasticDepth
from collections import OrderedDict
from torchvision.ops import Conv2dNormActivation

class LayerNormChannels(nn.LayerNorm):

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
        x = F.layer_norm(x, self.normalized_shape, self.weight, self.bias, self.eps)
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        return x

class ConvNeXtBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = LayerNormChannels(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(dim, 4 * dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(self.pwconv1.out_channels, dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.drop_path = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, inp):
        shortcut = inp
        inp = self.dwconv(inp)
        inp = self.norm(inp)
        inp = self.pwconv1(inp)
        inp = self.act(inp)
        inp = self.pwconv2(inp)
        inp = shortcut + self.drop_path(inp)
        return inp

class NormMlpHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

class ConvNet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, settings, in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, output_stride=32, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=4, stride=4), LayerNormChannels(16, eps=1e-06))
        in_ch = 16
        total = sum((r[1] for r in settings))

        cur = 0
        self.feature_info = []

        for idx, (dim, n) in enumerate(settings):
            blocks = []

            for j in range(n):

class NormMlpHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def __init__(self, num_input_features, growth_rate, bn_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_input_features)
        self.relu1 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.Hardswish(inplace=True)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(num_input_features, bn_size * growth_rate, kernel_size=1, bias=False)

        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(bn_size * growth_rate, growth_rate, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, input):
        out = self.conv1(self.relu1(self.norm1(input)))
        out = self.conv2(self.relu2(self.norm2(out)))
        return out

class _DenseBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_input_features, bn_size, growth_rate):
        super().__init__()
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([DenseLayer(num_input_features + i * growth_rate, growth_rate, bn_size) for i in range(num_layers)])

    def forward(self, input):
        feats_list = [input]
        for layer in self.layers:
            new = layer(torch.cat(feats_list, 1))
            feats_list.append(new)
        return torch.cat(feats_list, 1)

        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('conv', nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 8, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)), ('bn', norm_layer(8)), ('act', nn.Hardswish(inplace=True))]))
        in_ch = 8
        for idx, (n,) in enumerate(settings):
            last = idx == len(settings) - 1
            blocks = []
            blocks.append(_DenseBlock(n, in_ch, 2, 8))
            in_ch = in_ch + n * 8
            if not last:
                blocks.append(_Transition(in_ch, in_ch // 2))
                in_ch = in_ch // 2
            self.add_module(f'stage{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
        self.num_stages = len(settings)

        for i in range(self.num_stages):
            input = getattr(self, f'stage{i + 1}')(input)
        input = self.global_pool(input)
        return self.classifier(input)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torchvision.ops import Conv2dNormActivation
from functools import partial
from collections import OrderedDict

def conv3x3(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1, groups=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False)

def conv1x1(in_planes, out_planes, stride=1):
    return nn.Conv2d(in_planes, out_planes, kernel_size=1, stride=stride, bias=False)

class SkipBlock(nn.Module):
    expansion = 1

    def __init__(self, inplanes, planes, stride=1, skip=None, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        self.conv_a = conv3x3(inplanes, planes, stride)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.conv_b = conv3x3(planes, planes)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(planes)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU6(inplace=True)
        self.skip = skip
        self.stride = stride

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        y = self.conv_a(x)
        y = self.norm1(y)
        y = self.relu1(y)
        y = self.conv_b(y)
        y = self.norm2(y)
        if self.skip is not None:
            residual = self.skip(x)
        y += residual
        y = self.relu2(y)
        return y

class Network(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, stage_cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, output_stride=32):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = Conv2dNormActivation(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        in_ch = 16
        self.feature_info = []
        stages = OrderedDict()
        for idx, (planes, n, stride) in enumerate(stage_cfg):
            blocks = []
            downsample = None
            if stride != 1 or in_ch != planes * SkipBlock.expansion:
                downsample = nn.Sequential(conv1x1(in_ch, planes * SkipBlock.expansion, stride), norm_layer(planes * SkipBlock.expansion))
            blocks.append(SkipBlock(in_ch, planes, stride, downsample))
            in_ch = planes * SkipBlock.expansion
            for _ in range(1, n):
                blocks.append(SkipBlock(in_ch, planes))
            stages[f'layer{idx + 1}'] = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stages.layer{idx + 1}'))
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(stages)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.conv_head = Conv2dNormActivation(in_ch, 128, kernel_size=1)
        in_ch = 128
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Identity()
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.dim() == 4, f'expected a 4D input, got {x.dim()}D')
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        x = self.conv_head(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def _network(variant, weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    cfgs = {'small': [(8, 3, 1), (16, 1, 2), (32, 2, 2), (64, 2, 2), (128, 1, 2)], 'base': [(8, 4, 1), (16, 2, 2), (32, 3, 2), (64, 3, 2), (128, 2, 2)]}
    model = Network(cfgs[variant], **kwargs)
    if weights is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(weights.get_state_dict(progress=progress))
    return model

def network_small(weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    return _network('base', weights, progress, **kwargs)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from collections import OrderedDict

def _drop_path(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

class DropPath(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, drop_prob=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob

    def forward(self, x):
        return _drop_path(x, self.drop_prob, self.training)

class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class FeedForward(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        out_features = out_features or in_features
        hidden_features = hidden_features or in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = MultiHeadAttention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = FeedForward(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.drop_path1 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class TransformerStage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_dim, dim, depth, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, downsample=True):
        super().__init__()
        if downsample:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_dim, dim, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(dim))
        else:
            assert in_dim == dim
            self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderBlock(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.downsample(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        return x

class TinyViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dims=(32, 64, 128), depths=(2, 2, 2), num_heads=(1, 2, 4), mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        assert len(embed_dims) == len(depths) == len(num_heads)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dims[0], kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        stages = []
        in_dim = embed_dims[0]
        for i, (dim, depth, heads) in enumerate(zip(embed_dims, depths, num_heads)):
            stages.append(TransformerStage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = embed_dims[-1]
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('flatten', nn.Flatten(1)), ('fc', nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes))]))

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=(2, 3))
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def vit_staged_tiny(**kwargs):

class SelfAttention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if out_features is None:
            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class Block(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.attn = SelfAttention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):

        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))

        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[Block(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        return x

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dims=(32, 64, 128), depths=(2, 2, 2), num_heads=(1, 2, 4), mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert len(embed_dims) == len(depths) == len(num_heads)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dims[0], kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.feature_info = []
        stages = []
        in_dim = embed_dims[0]
        for i, (dim, depth, heads) in enumerate(zip(embed_dims, depths, num_heads)):
            stages.append(ViTStage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=dim, module=f'stages.{i}'))
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = embed_dims[-1]
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

        x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=(2, 3))
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x
