class SHMA(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, ratio=1, head_dim_reduction_ratio=2, window_size=0, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        mid_dim = int(dim * ratio)
        dim_attn = dim // head_dim_reduction_ratio
        self.scale = dim_attn ** (-0.5)
        self.fused_attn = use_fused_attn()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.q = ConvNorm(dim, dim_attn, 1, 1, 0, **dd)
        self.k = ConvNorm(dim, dim_attn, 1, 1, 0, **dd)
        self.v_gate = ConvNorm(dim, 2 * mid_dim, 1, 1, 0, **dd)
        self.gate_act = nn.Sigmoid()
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(0.0)
        self.proj = ConvNorm(mid_dim, dim, 1, **dd)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, _, H, W = x.shape
        do_window = self.window_size and self.window_size > 0
        if do_window:
            pad_r = (self.window_size - W % self.window_size) % self.window_size
            pad_b = (self.window_size - H % self.window_size) % self.window_size
            x_pad = F.pad(x, (0, pad_r, 0, pad_b))
            Ho, Wo = (H, W)
            _, _, Hp, Wp = x_pad.shape
            x = self._window_partition(x_pad, self.window_size)
            B, _, H, W = x.shape
        else:
            Ho = Wo = Hp = Wp = pad_r = pad_b = 0
        v, gate = self.gate_act(self.v_gate(x)).chunk(2, dim=1)
        q = self.q(x).flatten(2)
        k = self.k(x).flatten(2)
        v = v.flatten(2)
        if self.fused_attn:
            q_t = q.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            k_t = k.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            v_t = v.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            x_attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q_t, k_t, v_t, dropout_p=self.attn_drop.p if self.training else 0.0)
            x_attn = x_attn.transpose(-1, -2).reshape(B, -1, H, W)
        else:
            q_s = q * self.scale
            attn = (q_s.transpose(-2, -1) @ k).softmax(dim=-1)
            attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
            x_attn = (v @ attn.transpose(-2, -1)).view(B, -1, H, W)
        x_out = self.proj(x_attn * gate)
        if do_window:
            x_out = self._window_reverse(x_out, self.window_size, Hp, Wp)
            if pad_r > 0 or pad_b > 0:
                x_out = x_out[:, :, :Ho, :Wo].contiguous()
        return x_out

    @staticmethod
    def _window_partition(x, window_size):
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.view(B, C, H // window_size, window_size, W // window_size, window_size)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5).contiguous().view(-1, C, window_size, window_size)
        return x

    @staticmethod
    def _window_reverse(windows, window_size, H, W):
        _, C, _, _ = windows.shape
        B = windows.shape[0] // (H // window_size * (W // window_size))
        x = windows.view(B, H // window_size, W // window_size, C, window_size, window_size)
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5).contiguous().view(B, C, H, W)
        return x

        do_window = self.window_size and self.window_size > 0
        if do_window:
            pad_r = (self.window_size - W % self.window_size) % self.window_size
            pad_b = (self.window_size - H % self.window_size) % self.window_size
            x_pad = F.pad(x, (0, pad_r, 0, pad_b))
            Ho, Wo = (H, W)
            _, _, Hp, Wp = x_pad.shape
            x = self._window_partition(x_pad, self.window_size)
            B, _, H, W = x.shape
        else:
            Ho = Wo = Hp = Wp = pad_r = pad_b = 0
        v, gate = self.gate_act(self.v_gate(x)).chunk(2, dim=1)
        q = self.q(x).flatten(2)
        k = self.k(x).flatten(2)
        v = v.flatten(2)
        if self.fused_attn:
            q_t = q.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            k_t = k.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            v_t = v.transpose(-1, -2).unsqueeze(1)
            x_attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q_t, k_t, v_t, dropout_p=self.attn_drop.p if self.training else 0.0)
            x_attn = x_attn.transpose(-1, -2).reshape(B, -1, H, W)
        else:
            q_s = q * self.scale
            attn = (q_s.transpose(-2, -1) @ k).softmax(dim=-1)
            attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
            x_attn = (v @ attn.transpose(-2, -1)).view(B, -1, H, W)
        x_out = self.proj(x_attn * gate)
        if do_window:
            x_out = self._window_reverse(x_out, self.window_size, Hp, Wp)
            if pad_r > 0 or pad_b > 0:
                x_out = x_out[:, :, :Ho, :Wo].contiguous()
        return x_out

    @staticmethod
    def _window_partition(x, window_size):
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.view(B, C, H // window_size, window_size, W // window_size, window_size)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5).contiguous().view(-1, C, window_size, window_size)
        return x

    @staticmethod
    def _window_reverse(windows, window_size, H, W):
        _, C, _, _ = windows.shape
        B = windows.shape[0] // (H // window_size * (W // window_size))
        x = windows.view(B, H // window_size, W // window_size, C, window_size, window_size)
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5).contiguous().view(B, C, H, W)
        return x

class Attention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        q = q * self.scale
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
        x = attn @ v
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if out_features is None:
            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = Attention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.drop_path1 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class Stem(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer is not None else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class TinyViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, global_pool='token', representation_size=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.patch_embed = Stem(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        dpr = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, depth)]
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, drop_path=dpr[i]) for i in range(depth)])
        self.feature_info = [dict(module=f'blocks.{i}', num_chs=embed_dim, reduction=patch_size) for i in range(depth)]
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        heads = OrderedDict()
        if representation_size is None:
            heads['head'] = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes)
        else:
            heads['pre_logits'] = nn.Linear(embed_dim, representation_size)
            heads['act'] = nn.Tanh()
            heads['head'] = nn.Linear(representation_size, num_classes)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(heads)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        x = torch.cat((self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1), x), dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def create_vit(**kwargs):
    model_args = dict(img_size=64, patch_size=8, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=2)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor
from functools import partial
from collections import OrderedDict

def stochastic_depth(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

class DropPath(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, drop_prob=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.drop_prob = drop_prob

    def forward(self, x):
        return stochastic_depth(x, self.drop_prob, self.training)

class MLP(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if out_features is None:
            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, num_heads, dropout=attn_drop, batch_first=True)
        self.norm2 = norm_layer(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.drop_path1 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = DropPath(drop_path) if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.norm1(x)
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)[0])
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class Stage(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_dim, dim, depth, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, downsample=True):
        super().__init__()
        if downsample:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_dim, dim, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(dim))
        else:
            assert in_dim == dim
            self.downsample = nn.Identity()
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[EncoderBlock(dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.downsample(x)
        B, C, H, W = x.shape
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, H, W)
        return x

class ViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dims=(32, 64, 128), depths=(2, 2, 2), num_heads=(1, 2, 4), mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert len(embed_dims) == len(depths) == len(num_heads)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dims[0], kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        stages = []
        in_dim = embed_dims[0]
        for i, (dim, depth, heads) in enumerate(zip(embed_dims, depths, num_heads)):
            stages.append(Stage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = embed_dims[-1]
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('flatten', nn.Flatten(1)), ('fc', nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes))]))

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=(2, 3))
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, **kwargs):
        super(BasicConv, self).__init__()

        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))

    def __init__(self, in_channels, ch1, ch2, ch3, pool_features, conv_block=None):
        super(MixedBlock, self).__init__()
        if conv_block is None:
            conv_block = BasicConv
        self.branch_a = conv_block(in_channels, ch1, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch2, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_b_2 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(7, 1), padding=(3, 0))
        self.branch_b_3 = conv_block(ch2, ch2, kernel_size=(1, 3), padding=(0, 1))
        self.branch_c_1 = conv_block(in_channels, ch3, kernel_size=1)
        self.branch_c_2 = conv_block(ch3, ch3, kernel_size=(1, 7), padding=(0, 3))
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.branch_pool = conv_block(in_channels, pool_features, kernel_size=1)

    def _forward(self, x):
        br1 = self.branch_a(x)
        b2 = self.branch_b_1(x)
        b2 = self.branch_b_2(b2)
        b2 = self.branch_b_3(b2)
        y3 = self.branch_c_1(x)
        y3 = self.branch_c_2(y3)
        bp = self.pool(x)
        bp = self.branch_pool(bp)
        return [br1, b2, y3, bp]

    def forward(self, x):
        outputs = self._forward(x)
        return torch.cat(outputs, 1)

from torchvision.ops import MLP

class Attention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = Attention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, [hidden, dim], activation_layer=nn.GELU, dropout=drop)
        self.drop_path1 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()
        self.drop_path2 = StochasticDepth(drop_path, 'row') if drop_path > 0.0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.drop_path1(self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

class PatchEmbed(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.1, global_pool='token'):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbed(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        dpr = [x.item() for x in torch.linspace(0, drop_path_rate, depth)]
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([TransformerBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, drop_path=dpr[i]) for i in range(depth)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)

    def forward(self, x):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=False, drop=0.0, attn_drop=0.0, init_values=None):

        hidden = int(dim * mlp_ratio)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.attn = Attention(dim, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, attn_drop=attn_drop, proj_drop=drop)
        self.ls1 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp = Mlp(dim, hidden, drop=drop)
        self.ls2 = LayerScale(dim, init_values) if init_values else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.ls1(self.attn(self.norm1(x)))
        x = x + self.ls2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))
        return x

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, embed_dim=64, norm_layer=None):
        super(PatchEmbedding, self).__init__()
        self.num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        self.norm = norm_layer(embed_dim) if norm_layer else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

class TinyViT(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, img_size=32, patch_size=4, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, embed_dim=64, depth=4, num_heads=4, mlp_ratio=4.0, qkv_bias=True, drop_rate=0.0, init_values=None, global_pool='token', **kwargs):
        super(TinyViT, self).__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        assert global_pool in ('token', 'avg')
        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.patch_embed = PatchEmbedding(img_size, patch_size, in_chans, embed_dim, norm_layer=nn.LayerNorm)
        num_patches = self.patch_embed.num_patches
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, num_patches + 1, embed_dim))
        self.pos_drop = nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([EncoderBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, init_values=init_values) for i in range(depth)])
        self.feature_info = [dict(module=f'blocks.{i}', num_chs=embed_dim, reduction=patch_size) for i in range(depth)]
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        torch._assert(x.shape[1] == 3, 'expected 3 input channels')
        x = self.patch_embed(x)
        x = torch.cat((self.cls_token.expand(x.shape[0], -1, -1), x), dim=1)
        x = x + self.pos_embed
        x = self.pos_drop(x)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x[:, 0] if self.global_pool == 'token' else x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def build_vit(**kwargs):
    model_args = dict(img_size=64, patch_size=8, embed_dim=32, depth=3, num_heads=4, init_values=1e-05)
    return TinyViT(**dict(model_args, **kwargs))

class Attention(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, num_heads=8, qkv_bias=False, attn_drop=0.0, proj_drop=0.0):
        super(Attention, self).__init__()
        assert dim % num_heads == 0, 'dim should be divisible by num_heads'
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim * 3, bias=qkv_bias)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(attn_drop)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.proj_drop = nn.Dropout(proj_drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(0)
        x = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, C)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = self.proj_drop(x)
        return x

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from functools import partial

def adjust_width(width, group_width):
    group_width = min(group_width, width)
    return int(round(width / group_width) * group_width)

class XBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch, stride, group_width, bottleneck_ratio=1.0, se_ratio=None):
        super().__init__()
        w_b = int(round(out_ch * bottleneck_ratio))
        groups = w_b // group_width
        self.a = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, w_b, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.b = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, w_b, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(w_b), nn.ReLU(inplace=True))
        self.se = None
        self.c = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(w_b, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.proj = None
        if in_ch != out_ch or stride != 1:
            self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, stride=stride, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch))
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, feats):
        shortcut = feats if self.proj is None else self.proj(feats)
        feats = self.a(feats)
        feats = self.b(feats)
        if self.se is not None:
            feats = self.se(feats)
        feats = self.c(feats)
        return self.act(feats + shortcut)

class ConvStem(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_chs, out_chs, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(in_chs, out_chs, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.norm = norm_layer(out_chs)
        self.act = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.pool(x)
        return x

class Classifier(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=10, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, output_stride=32, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=0.001)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = ConvStem(in_chans, 8, norm_layer=norm_layer)
        in_ch = 8
        self.feature_info = []
        stages = []
        for idx, (w, d, g) in enumerate(cfg):
            blocks = []
            w = adjust_width(w, g)
            for i in range(d):
                blocks.append(XBlock(in_ch, w, 2 if i == 0 else 1, g))
                in_ch = w
            stages.append(nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'stages.{idx}'))
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_ch, num_classes)

    def forward(self, feats):
        feats = self.stem(feats)
        feats = self.stages(feats)
        feats = feats.mean((-2, -1))
        feats = self.flatten(feats)
        feats = self.drop(feats)
        return self.fc(feats)

    cfgs = {'small': [(24, 2, 8), (32, 2, 16), (48, 1, 16)]}
    model = Classifier(cfgs[variant], **kwargs)
    if weights is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(weights.get_state_dict(progress=progress))
    return model

def classifier_small(weights=None, progress=True, **kwargs):
    return _classifier('small', weights, progress, **kwargs)

import torch

from collections import OrderedDict
from functools import partial

def conv_bn(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, stride=1, groups=1, act=True):
    padding = (kernel_size - 1) // 2 if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else tuple(((k - 1) // 2 for k in kernel_size))
    layers = [nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, stride=stride, padding=padding, groups=groups, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)]
    if act:
        layers.append(nn.ReLU())
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)

class SqueezeExcitation(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, channels, squeeze_channels):
        super(SqueezeExcitation, self).__init__()
        self.avgpool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, squeeze_channels, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv2d(squeeze_channels, channels, 1)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.scale_activation = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        scale = self.avgpool(x)
        scale = self.fc1(scale)
        scale = self.activation(scale)
        scale = self.fc2(scale)
        scale = self.scale_activation(scale)
        return scale * x

class InvertedResidual(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, inp, oup, stride, expand_ratio, use_se=False, norm_layer=None):
        super(InvertedResidual, self).__init__()
        self.stride = stride
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = nn.BatchNorm2d
        hidden_dim = int(round(inp * expand_ratio))
        self.use_res_connect = self.stride == 1 and inp == oup
        layers = []
        if expand_ratio != 1:
            layers.append(conv_bn(inp, hidden_dim, kernel_size=1))
        layers.append(conv_bn(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, stride=stride, groups=hidden_dim))
        if use_se:
            layers.append(SqueezeExcitation(hidden_dim, max(1, hidden_dim // 4)))
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(hidden_dim, oup, 1, 1, 0, bias=False))
        layers.append(norm_layer(oup))
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.conv(x)
        if self.use_res_connect:
            out = out + x
        return out

class PoolHead(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, num_classes, drop_rate=0.0):
        super(PoolHead, self).__init__()
        self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten(1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(in_features, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = self.global_pool(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.fc(x)

    def __init__(self, cfg, in_chans=3, num_classes=100, drop_rate=0.0, norm_layer=None, output_stride=32, **kwargs):
        super(Model, self).__init__()
        assert output_stride in (8, 16, 32)
        if norm_layer is None:
            norm_layer = partial(nn.BatchNorm2d, eps=1e-05)
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('conv', nn.Conv2d(in_chans, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False)), ('bn', norm_layer(16)), ('act', nn.ReLU())]))
        in_ch = 16
        self.feature_info = []
        for idx, (t, c, n, stride, se) in enumerate(cfg):
            blocks = []
            out_c = c
            for i in range(n):
                blocks.append(InvertedResidual(in_ch, out_c, stride if i == 0 else 1, t, use_se=se))
                in_ch = out_c
            self.add_module(f'layer{idx + 1}', nn.Sequential(*blocks))
            self.feature_info.append(dict(num_chs=in_ch, module=f'layer{idx + 1}'))
        self.num_stages = len(cfg)
        self.num_features = in_ch
        self.head = PoolHead(in_ch, num_classes, drop_rate=drop_rate)

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        for i in range(self.num_stages):
            x = getattr(self, f'layer{i + 1}')(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        return self.head(x, pre_logits=pre_logits)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def build_model(variant='small', **kwargs):

class Attention(torch.nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim=384, key_dim=32, num_heads=8, attn_ratio=4, resolution=7, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.scale = key_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.key_dim = key_dim
        self.key_attn_dim = key_dim * num_heads
        self.val_dim = int(attn_ratio * key_dim)
        self.val_attn_dim = self.val_dim * num_heads
        self.attn_ratio = attn_ratio
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, self.key_attn_dim * 2 + self.val_attn_dim, **dd)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(self.val_attn_dim, dim, **dd)
        resolution = to_2tuple(resolution)
        pos = torch.stack(ndgrid(torch.arange(resolution[0], device=device, dtype=torch.long), torch.arange(resolution[1], device=device, dtype=torch.long))).flatten(1)
        rel_pos = (pos[..., :, None] - pos[..., None, :]).abs()
        rel_pos = rel_pos[0] * resolution[1] + rel_pos[1]
        self.attention_biases = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_heads, resolution[0] * resolution[1], **dd))
        self.register_buffer('attention_bias_idxs', rel_pos)
        self.attention_bias_cache = {}

    def get_attention_biases(self, device):
        if torch.jit.is_tracing() or self.training:
            return self.attention_biases[:, self.attention_bias_idxs]
        else:
            device_key = str(device)
            if device_key not in self.attention_bias_cache:
                self.attention_bias_cache[device_key] = self.attention_biases[:, self.attention_bias_idxs]
            return self.attention_bias_cache[device_key]

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x)
        qkv = qkv.reshape(B, N, self.num_heads, -1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.key_dim, self.key_dim, self.val_dim], dim=3)
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.scale
        attn = attn + self.get_attention_biases(x.device)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        x = (attn @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, self.val_attn_dim)
        x = self.proj(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self, depths=(3, 2, 6, 4), embed_dims=(48, 96, 224, 448), in_chans=3, num_classes=1000, global_pool='avg', downsamples=None, num_vit=0, mlp_ratios=4, pool_size=3, layer_scale_init_value=1e-05, act_layer=nn.GELU, norm_layer=nn.BatchNorm2d, norm_layer_cl=nn.LayerNorm, drop_rate=0.0, proj_drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.0, img_size=None, device=None, dtype=None):
        super().__init__()
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.in_chans = in_chans

        self.global_pool = global_pool
        self.stem = Stem4(in_chans, embed_dims[0], norm_layer=norm_layer, **dd)
        prev_dim = embed_dims[0]
        self.num_stages = len(depths)
        last_stage = self.num_stages - 1
        dpr = calculate_drop_path_rates(drop_path_rate, depths, stagewise=True)
        downsamples = downsamples or (False,) + (True,) * (self.num_stages - 1)
        stages = []
        self.feature_info = []
        for i in range(self.num_stages):
            stage = EfficientFormerStage(prev_dim, embed_dims[i], depths[i], downsample=downsamples[i], num_vit=num_vit if i == last_stage else 0, pool_size=pool_size, mlp_ratio=mlp_ratios, act_layer=act_layer, norm_layer_cl=norm_layer_cl, norm_layer=norm_layer, proj_drop=proj_drop_rate, drop_path=dpr[i], layer_scale_init_value=layer_scale_init_value, **dd)
            prev_dim = embed_dims[i]
            stages.append(stage)
            self.feature_info += [dict(num_chs=embed_dims[i], reduction=2 ** (i + 2), module=f'stages.{i}')]
        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)
        self.num_features = self.head_hidden_size = embed_dims[-1]
        self.norm = norm_layer_cl(self.num_features, **dd)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes, **dd) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()
        self.head_dist = nn.Linear(embed_dims[-1], num_classes, **dd) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()
        self.distilled_training = False

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = self.stages(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        if self.global_pool == 'avg':
            x = x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        if pre_logits:
            return x
        x, x_dist = (self.head(x), self.head_dist(x))
        if self.distilled_training and self.training and (not torch.jit.is_scripting()):
            return (x, x_dist)
        else:
            return (x + x_dist) / 2

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x

def checkpoint_filter_fn(state_dict, model):
    if 'stem.0.weight' in state_dict:
        return state_dict
    out_dict = {}
    import re
    stage_idx = 0
    for k, v in state_dict.items():
        if k.startswith('patch_embed'):
            k = k.replace('patch_embed.0', 'stem.conv1')
            k = k.replace('patch_embed.1', 'stem.norm1')
            k = k.replace('patch_embed.3', 'stem.conv2')
            k = k.replace('patch_embed.4', 'stem.norm2')
        if re.match('network\\.(\\d+)\\.proj\\.weight', k):
            stage_idx += 1
        k = re.sub('network.(\\d+).(\\d+)', f'stages.{stage_idx}.blocks.\\2', k)
        k = re.sub('network.(\\d+).proj', f'stages.{stage_idx}.downsample.conv', k)
        k = re.sub('network.(\\d+).norm', f'stages.{stage_idx}.downsample.norm', k)
        k = re.sub('layer_scale_([0-9])', 'ls\\1.gamma', k)
        k = k.replace('dist_head', 'head_dist')
        out_dict[k] = v
    return out_dict

class Attention(torch.nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim=384, key_dim=32, num_heads=8, attn_ratio=4, resolution=7, device=None, dtype=None):
        dd = {'device': device, 'dtype': dtype}
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.scale = key_dim ** (-0.5)
        self.key_dim = key_dim
        self.key_attn_dim = key_dim * num_heads
        self.val_dim = int(attn_ratio * key_dim)
        self.val_attn_dim = self.val_dim * num_heads
        self.attn_ratio = attn_ratio
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(dim, self.key_attn_dim * 2 + self.val_attn_dim, **dd)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(self.val_attn_dim, dim, **dd)
        resolution = to_2tuple(resolution)
        pos = torch.stack(ndgrid(torch.arange(resolution[0], device=device, dtype=torch.long), torch.arange(resolution[1], device=device, dtype=torch.long))).flatten(1)
        rel_pos = (pos[..., :, None] - pos[..., None, :]).abs()
        rel_pos = rel_pos[0] * resolution[1] + rel_pos[1]
        self.attention_biases = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_heads, resolution[0] * resolution[1], **dd))
        self.register_buffer('attention_bias_idxs', rel_pos)
        self.attention_bias_cache = {}

    def get_attention_biases(self, device):
        if torch.jit.is_tracing() or self.training:
            return self.attention_biases[:, self.attention_bias_idxs]
        else:
            device_key = str(device)
            if device_key not in self.attention_bias_cache:
                self.attention_bias_cache[device_key] = self.attention_biases[:, self.attention_bias_idxs]
            return self.attention_bias_cache[device_key]

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, C = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x)
        qkv = qkv.reshape(B, N, self.num_heads, -1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.key_dim, self.key_dim, self.val_dim], dim=3)
        attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.scale
        attn = attn + self.get_attention_biases(x.device)
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        x = (attn @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, self.val_attn_dim)
        x = self.proj(x)
        return x

def drop_path(x, drop_prob=0.0, training=False):
    if drop_prob == 0.0 or not training:
        return x
    keep_prob = 1 - drop_prob
    shape = (x.shape[0],) + (1,) * (x.ndim - 1)
    random_tensor = x.new_empty(shape).bernoulli_(keep_prob)
    return x * random_tensor / keep_prob

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):

            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x

        x = x + self.drop_path2(self.mlp(self.norm2(x)))

        self.num_classes = num_classes

        self.feature_info = []

            stages.append(TransformerStage(in_dim, dim, depth, heads, mlp_ratio, qkv_bias=qkv_bias, drop=drop_rate, downsample=i > 0))
            in_dim = dim

        self.stages = nn.Sequential(*stages)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(OrderedDict([('flatten', nn.Flatten(1)), ('fc', nn.Linear(self.num_features, num_classes))]))

class FeedForward(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features=None, out_features=None, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        if out_features is None:
            out_features = in_features
        if hidden_features is None:
            hidden_features = in_features
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.drop1 = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features)
        self.drop2 = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop2(x)
        return x
